title: Recursive pass — Palantir AMNC speaker resolution depth 5
summary: The AMNC person-level search did not resolve a named Palantir attendee in indexed public materials and therefore pivoted to Katherine Hsiao's directly documented WEF Data Policy council service.

sources.title: Annual Meeting of the New Champions 2026 — Overview

data.research_question: Which Palantir personnel are named in AMNC 2026 materials and what direct WEF personnel link should be recursed next?
data.method: Primary-source WEF meeting and personnel-profile review.
classification_rules: No name resolved means unresolved, not absent.
Partner status does not imply attendance.
Council membership does not imply authorship or policy adoption.

findings.finding: No named Palantir AMNC 2026 participant was source-verified in indexed public materials in this pass.
Katherine Hsiao has a direct WEF Global Future Council for Data Policy service link documented by WEF.
